Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses BID DOCUMENT / BUYER SPECIFIC TERMS & CONDITIONS SUPPLY, INSTALLATION, INTEGRATION, TESTING, COMMISSIONING AND ONEYEAR SERVICE SUPPORT OF CCTV SURVEILLANCE SYSTEM WITH MOBILE APP AND ONLINE/CLOUD ACCESS 1. INTRODUCTION CSMCARI intends to procure through GeM services for fresh installation, integration, testing and commissioning of CCTV surveillance facilities, including cameras, poles, cabling, networking, power/accessories, configuration, integration with the Institute’s existing CCTV systems and the 64-channe l NVR already procured by the Institute, together with one-year post-installation service support. The system shall additionally provide authorised users with live/remote access through the relevant

OEM/compatible CCTV mobile application and a secure online/cloud-based viewing arrangement, subject to internet connectivity, OEM/platform availability and applicable Government information-security requirem ents. 2. SITE PARTICULARS Particular Details Land area Approx. 8,400 sq. ft. Building Ground + 3 Floors Floor area Approx. 7,200 sq. ft. per floor Existing main CCTV 4-channel NVR in AD-in-charge Room, Second Floor Existing Animal House CCTV Approx. 12 cameras with DVR, Ground Floor New NVR available 64-channel NVR New cameras available 08 Nos. Fresh installation 08 Nos. cameras Service support 01 year after successful commissioning 3. OBJECTIVE a) Boundary and selected internal surveillance coverage. b) Integration of the 08 new cameras with the 64-channel NVR. c) Integration, wherever technically feasible, of the existing 4-channel system and Animal House DVR system. d) Combined monitoring at the AD-in-charge Room, Second Floor and Animal House monitoring point, Ground Floor. e) Authorised live remote access through the relevant CCTV mobile application. f) Secure online/cloud access to the authorised CCTV feed, subject to internet and platform availability. g) Provision for future expansion of cameras. 4. FRESH CCTV INSTALLATION Sl. Location Cameras (a) Front boundary – one corner/pole 02 (b) Front boundary – opposite corner/pole 01 (c) Rear boundary – one corner/pole 01 (d) Rear boundary – opposite corner/pole 01 (e) Library – Third Floor 01 (f) Administration Office – Second Floor 01 (g) Conference Hall – Third Floor 01 TOTAL 08

5. COMPLETE SCOPE OF WORK The bidder shall undertake complete Supply–Installation–Integration–Testing–Commissioning (SITC), including poles (4 Nos 8 ft height each), brackets, foundation/fixing, cabling (600 mtr Cat 6e cable), conduits/trunking, connectors, switches/PoE equipment (8-Port Switch – 01 Nos and 4 Port Switches 5 Nos), junction boxes, power arrangements, NVR configuration, integration, mobile application configuration, cloud/online configuration, testing, documentation, training and one-year service support. All ordinary accessories necessary for successful commissioning shall be included in the quoted comprehensive price. 6. BOUNDARY POLES Four suitable poles/mounting structures shall be provided at the identified boundary locations, including suitable GI/MS or equivalent poles, foundations/base plates, camera brackets, weatherproof junction boxes , cable protection, anti-corrosion treatment and associated installation/protection. Final height and exact loc ation shall be determined during site survey with the Institute. 7. EXISTING SYSTEMS AND 64-CHANNEL NVR The existing 4-channel NVR system in the AD-in-charge Room and the approximately 12-camera Animal House DVR system shall be examined and integrated with the proposed surveillance arrangement wherever technically feasible. The newly procured 64-channel NVR shall be configured for the 08 new cam eras and compatible existing feeds. The bidder shall verify make/model, protocol, firmware and interfaces befor e installation. The bidder shall provide a combined Animal House feed at the Animal House entrance/monitoring point and at the AD-in-charge Room, subject to technical compatibility. 8. CAMERA AND INSTALLATION REQUIREMENTS Outdoor cameras shall be IP/network based, suitable for 24×7 operation, weather resistant, minimum Full HD or better, with day/night operation, IR/night vision, motion/event detection, efficient compression s uch as H.265/H.265+ or equivalent and ONVIF or demonstrably compatible protocol. Indoor cameras shall be suitable for 24×7 surveillance, minimum Full HD or better and compatible with the NVR. The bidder shall supply and install all Cat-6/Cat-6A or suitable network cable, outdoor-rated cable where required, power cable, conduit/trunking, RJ-45 connectors, patch cords, network/PoE switches, injec tors, junction boxes, glands, cable markers, surge protection, earthing and all other required accessories. 9. CENTRAL MONITORING The AD-in-charge Room, Second Floor, shall be configured as the primary central monitoring location for the new cameras and compatible existing systems, supporting live multi-camera view, recording status, playback and retrieval. A suitable monitoring arrangement shall also be provided at the Animal House entrance/monitoring point.

10. MOBILE APPLICATION / REMOTE ACCESS The system shall provide authorised users with secure remote access through the relevant OEM/compatible CCTV mobile application (Android/iOS or equivalent as supported by the offered system). a) Live viewing of authorised cameras remotely. b) Remote playback/search of recorded footage where supported. c) Configuration of device registration, authorised user accounts and permissions. d) Demonstration of successful remote access before commissioning. e) Secure authentication and password controls. f) Basic user training for the mobile application. 11. ONLINE / CLOUD ACCESS – MANDATORY REQUIREMENT The bidder shall provide/configure a secure online/cloud-based access facility so that authorised users can access the CCTV live feed remotely through the internet on an always-available basis, subject to availa bility of the Institute’s internet connection, electricity and the OEM/cloud platform. a) Cloud/online facility shall be compatible with the offered CCTV/NVR system. b) Live viewing of authorised cameras shall be available through the cloud/online facility. c) Where cloud recording/storage is supported and required, the bidder shall state storage capacity, retention period and subscription/licence period included. d) Any recurring cloud, storage, licence or subscription charges necessary to maintain the required service shall be clearly disclosed and included for the period specified in the bid. e) The bidder shall not represent local NVR storage as cloud storage. f) The Institute shall have administrative control of the relevant account wherever technically and contractually feasible. g) The bidder shall securely hand over account/device-linking details to authorised Institute personnel. h) The bidder shall state all bandwidth, internet, subscription and OEM dependencies. 12. RECORDING, STORAGE AND FUTURE EXPANSION The bidder shall configure recording in accordance with available NVR/storage capacity and state expected retention based on resolution, frame rate and recording mode. Playback/export shall be demonstrated. Th e system shall retain scope for future addition of cameras subject to available NVR channels, storage, netwo rk and power capacity. The bidder shall indicate the spare capacity after the present installation. 13. INSTALLATION, TESTING AND ACCEPTANCE a) Live view of every new camera. b) Recording and playback. c) Night vision and image quality. d) 64-channel NVR configuration.

e) Integration of existing systems wherever technically feasible. f) Central monitoring at AD-in-charge Room. g) Animal House combined monitoring feed. h) Mobile application live remote viewing. i) Online/cloud live remote viewing. j) Authentication and access control. k) Backup/export of footage. l) Power restoration/restart functionality. m) Demonstration to authorised Institute personnel. 14. DOCUMENTATION AND HANDOVER a. As-installed CCTV layout and camera location chart. b. Camera/channel mapping and IP address list. c. Cable route/network diagram. d. NVR configuration details. e. Mobile application and cloud account/device-linking details handed over securely. f. Make/model/serial-number list. g. Warranty documents and manuals. h. Configuration backup. i. Service contact details. j. Testing and commissioning report. 15. ONE-YEAR SERVICE SUPPORT The bidder shall provide one-year service support from successful commissioning/acceptance, including fault diagnosis, camera/NVR/network configuration support, integration troubleshooting, mobile application/cloud access support, preventive inspection as required and rectification/replacement of defect ive supplied components covered under warranty/service. Suggested service response: complaint acknowledgement within 24 hours and site visit for major faults preferably within 48 hours, subject to the nature of the fault and site conditions. 16. SITE SURVEY The bidder shall undertake/arrange a site survey to assess actual camera coverage, pole locations, cable routes, power/network availability, existing equipment compatibility, monitoring locations, internet connectivity, cloud/app requirements and future expansion. Actual site conditions shall be taken into acco unt in the comprehensive quoted price. 17. TECHNICAL COMPLIANCE MATRIX Sl. Requirement Bidder’s Offered

PRICE QUOTATION The bidder shall quote a comprehensive price including equipment/materials, poles, cameras, cabling, networking, power accessories, installation, civil fixing/foundation work, configuration, integration, testing, commissioning, documentation, training and one-year service support. All recurring app/cloud/subscription/licence charges necessary to fulfil the stated remote-access requirement shall be cl early identified and included for the required period. 19. PAYMENT Payment shall be released after completion of installation, successful integration, testing and commissioning, satisfactory demonstration including mobile/cloud access, submission of documentation a nd acceptance by the authorised representative, in accordance with applicable GeM/GFR provisions and the G eM

contract. 20. WARRANTY All newly supplied equipment and installation shall carry at least one-year warranty/service support unless a higher period is offered. The bidder shall support the relevant mobile application and cloud/online configuration during the service period, subject to OEM/platform terms and internet availability. 21. SPECIAL INTEGRATION CONDITION The bidder shall specifically certify that the proposed CCTV solution can integrate with the 64-channel NVR already procured by the Institute. Any limitation in integrating the existing 4-channel NVR or Animal House DVR shall be disclosed before commencement of work. 22.
